name: cybersec-soc-simulator
description: Interactive SOC training platform: simulated Linux terminal, guided exercises, and incident response scenarios.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @soc/shared && npm run build --workspace @soc/server && npm run build --workspace @soc/client
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @soc/server & npm run dev --workspace @soc/client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build --workspace @soc/shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @soc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @soc/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @soc/client
